quarterly_data.quarter: Digital Realty press release: Digital Realty Enters Trkiye Through Formation of New Joint (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Digital Realty formed a joint venture with Ronesans Infrastructure (a Turkish investment company and international contractor) to develop and operate data centers across Turkiye, extending PlatformDIGITAL into the country. The JV's first investment is a data center campus in Ankara designed to support more than 22 megawatts (MW) of carrier-neutral IT capacity; land, power and permitting are already secured, early construction work has commenced, and completion is scheduled for 2028. The JV also intends to develop an additional data center in Istanbul. No ownership split or investment amount stated.
quarterly_data.figure: Ankara campus more than 22 MW, completion scheduled for 2028; Istanbul site planned
